title: Cooperate again tomorrow?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the value assigned to future cooperation.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the value assigned to future cooperation affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Advantage, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the value assigned to future cooperation in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Toy cooperation pays 3 forever, discounted by 0.8 each round. Defection pays 5 once, then zero. What is cooperation’s discounted advantage?
